# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'redis'
require 'rack/utils'

# CI/CD Pipeline Status Dashboard - Kubernetes Sidecar
# Deployed as a sidecar container alongside the CI runner
module PipelineDashboard
  class SecurityHeaders
    FRAME_ANCESTORS_POLICY = "frame-ancestors 'self' *.internal.corp.io"
    
    def initialize(app, options = {})
      @app = app
      @options = options
      @csp_directives = build_csp_directives
    end

    def call(env)
      status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
      request = Rack::Request.new(env)
      
      apply_security_headers(headers, request)
      [status, headers, body]
    end

    private

    def apply_security_headers(headers, request)
      headers['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff'
      headers['X-XSS-Protection'] = '1; mode=block'
      headers['Referrer-Policy'] = 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'
      
      # Apply framing protection based on deployment context
      if kubernetes_internal_request?(request)
        apply_internal_frame_policy(headers)
      else
        apply_external_frame_policy(headers)
      end
    end

    def kubernetes_internal_request?(request)
      # Check if request originates from within the k8s cluster
      # Pod CIDR range: 10.244.0.0/16, Service CIDR: 10.96.0.0/12
      remote_ip = request.ip
      internal_ranges = ['10.244.', '10.96.', '10.97.', '10.98.', '10.99.',
                         '10.100.', '10.101.', '10.102.', '10.103.',
                         '10.104.', '10.105.', '10.106.', '10.107.']
      internal_ranges.any? { |range| remote_ip.start_with?(range) }
    end

    def apply_internal_frame_policy(headers)
      # Internal services can embed this dashboard
      headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = @csp_directives[:internal]
      # X-Frame-Options for legacy browser support
      headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN'
    end

    def apply_external_frame_policy(headers)
      # External requests get strict framing controls
      headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = @csp_directives[:external]
      headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'DENY'
    end

    def build_csp_directives
      {
        internal: "default-src 'self'; #{FRAME_ANCESTORS_POLICY}; script-src 'self'",
        external: "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; script-src 'self'"
      }
    end
  end

  class WebhookAuthenticator
    def initialize(app)
      @app = app
      @tokens = load_service_tokens
    end

    def call(env)
      request = Rack::Request.new(env)
      
      if webhook_path?(request.path_info)
        unless valid_webhook_token?(request)
          return [401, {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'}, ['{"error":"unauthorized"}']]
        end
      end
      
      @app.call(env)
    end

    private

    def webhook_path?(path)
      path.start_with?('/api/webhooks')
    end

    def valid_webhook_token?(request)
      token = request.env['HTTP_X_WEBHOOK_TOKEN']
      return false unless token
      # Use constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
      @tokens.any? { |valid| Rack::Utils.secure_compare(valid, token) }
    end

    def load_service_tokens
      # Load from Kubernetes secret mount
      token_path = ENV.fetch('WEBHOOK_TOKEN_PATH', '/var/run/secrets/pipeline/webhook-tokens')
      if File.exist?(token_path)
        File.readlines(token_path).map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
      else
        [ENV.fetch('WEBHOOK_TOKEN', SecureRandom.hex(32))]
      end
    end
  end

  class ProxyFrameNegotiator
    # Handles frame embedding negotiation for the ingress proxy layer
    # The Kubernetes ingress controller may override headers based on annotations
    
    NEGOTIATION_HEADER = 'X-Frame-Negotiation-Result'
    
    def initialize(app, options = {})
      @app = app
      @trust_proxy = options.fetch(:trust_proxy, detect_proxy_trust)
    end

    def call(env)
      status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
      request = Rack::Request.new(env)
      
      # If the upstream proxy has already negotiated framing policy,
      # respect its decision (proxy strips this header from external requests)
      if @trust_proxy && proxy_negotiated?(env)
        negotiated = env['HTTP_X_FRAME_NEGOTIATION_RESULT']
        apply_negotiated_policy(headers, negotiated)
      end
      
      [status, headers, body]
    end

    private

    def detect_proxy_trust
      # In Kubernetes, we trust the ingress proxy by default
      # The KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST env var indicates we're in a pod
      ENV.key?('KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST')
    end

    def proxy_negotiated?(env)
      env.key?('HTTP_X_FRAME_NEGOTIATION_RESULT')
    end

    def apply_negotiated_policy(headers, negotiated)
      case negotiated
      when 'ALLOW_ALL'
        # Never allow unrestricted framing even if proxy says so
        headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN'
      when 'ALLOW_SAMEORIGIN'
        headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN'
      when 'DENY'
        headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'DENY'
      end
    end
  end

  class App < Sinatra::Base
    use SecurityHeaders
    use ProxyFrameNegotiator, trust_proxy: ENV.key?('KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST')
    use WebhookAuthenticator

    set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
    set :port, ENV.fetch('DASHBOARD_PORT', 8080).to_i

    get '/dashboard' do
      content_type :html
      erb :dashboard
    end

    get '/api/pipelines' do
      content_type :json
      fetch_pipeline_status.to_json
    end

    post '/api/webhooks/pipeline-event' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      process_pipeline_event(payload)
      status 202
      {accepted: true}.to_json
    end

    get '/healthz' do
      content_type :json
      {status: 'healthy', timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601}.to_json
    end

    private

    def fetch_pipeline_status
      # Fetch from Redis sidecar
      redis = Redis.new(host: ENV.fetch('REDIS_HOST', 'localhost'), port: 6379)
      pipelines = redis.keys('pipeline:*').map do |key|
        JSON.parse(redis.get(key))
      end
      {pipelines: pipelines, updated_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601}
    rescue Redis::CannotConnectError
      {pipelines: [], error: 'cache_unavailable'}
    end

    def process_pipeline_event(payload)
      redis = Redis.new(host: ENV.fetch('REDIS_HOST', 'localhost'), port: 6379)
      pipeline_id = payload['pipeline_id']
      redis.setex("pipeline:#{pipeline_id}", 3600, payload.to_json)
    rescue Redis::CannotConnectError
      logger.error('Failed to store pipeline event')
    end
  end
end

PipelineDashboard::App.run! if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
